274 @Slot(str, int, float)
275 def setConnectionParams(self, host: str, port: int, timeout_s: float) -> None: # noqa: N802
276 changed = False
277
278 host = host.strip()
279 if host and host != self._connection_host:
280 self._connection_host = host
281 changed = True
282
283 try:
284 safe_port = int(port)
285 if 1 <= safe_port <= 65535 and safe_port != self._connection_port:
286 self._connection_port = safe_port
287 changed = True
288 except (TypeError, ValueError):
289 pass
290
291 try:
292 safe_timeout = max(0.2, float(timeout_s))
293 if abs(safe_timeout - self._connection_timeout_s) > 1e-6:
294 self._connection_timeout_s = safe_timeout
295 changed = True
296 except (TypeError, ValueError):
297 pass
298
299 if changed:
300 self.sessionChanged.emit()
301 self._save_session_config()
302
303 @Slot(str, int, float)
304 def connectDevice(self, host: str, port: int, timeout_s: float) -> None: # noqa: N802
305 self.setConnectionParams(host, port, timeout_s)
306
307 if not self._connection_host:
308 self._set_status("Host/IP vacío")
309 return
310
311 if self._connecting:
312 self._append_log("Conexión en progreso")
313 return
314
315 if self._connected:
316 self._append_log("Ya hay una conexión activa")
317 return
318
319 self._connecting = True
320 self.connectionChanged.emit()
321 self._set_status(f"Conectando a {self._connection_host}:{self._connection_port}...")
322
323 self._connect_thread = threading.Thread(
324 target=self._connect_worker,
325 args=(self._connection_host, self._connection_port, self._connection_timeout_s),
326 daemon=True,
327 )
328 self._connect_thread.start()
329
330 def _connect_worker(self, host: str, port: int, timeout_s: float) -> None:
331 client: ScpiTcpClient | None = None
332 instrument: N6705PowerAnalyzer | None = None
333 try:
334 client = ScpiTcpClient(
335 host=host,
336 port=port,
337 timeout_s=timeout_s,
338 )
339 instrument = N6705PowerAnalyzer(client)
340 instrument.connect()
341 idn = instrument.identify()
342 channel_count = 4
343 try:
344 channel_count = instrument.get_channel_count()
345 except Exception:
346 channel_count = 4
347 self.connectWorkerDone.emit(True, idn, channel_count, client, instrument)
348 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
349 if client is not None:
350 try:
351 client.disconnect()
352 except Exception: # noqa: BLE001
353 pass
354 self.connectWorkerDone.emit(False, str(exc), 4, None, None)
355
356 @Slot(bool, str, int, object, object)
357 def _on_connect_worker_done(
358 self,
359 success: bool,
360 payload: str,
361 channel_count: int,
362 client: object,
363 instrument: object,
364 ) -> None:
365 self._connect_thread = None
366 self._connecting = False
367 self.connectionChanged.emit()
368
369 if not success:
370 self._set_status(f"Error de conexión: {payload}")
371 self._safe_disconnect_internals()
372 return
373
374 self._client = client if isinstance(client, ScpiTcpClient) else None
375 self._instrument = instrument if isinstance(instrument, N6705PowerAnalyzer) else None
376 if self._client is None or self._instrument is None:
377 self._set_status("Error interno de conexión")
378 self._safe_disconnect_internals()
379 return
380
381 self._idn = payload
382 self._connected = True
383 new_count = max(1, min(4, int(channel_count)))
384 if self._channel_count != new_count:
385 self._channel_count = new_count
386 self.channelCountChanged.emit()
387 if self._chart_channel > self._channel_count:
388 self._chart_channel = self._channel_count
389 self.chartSelectionChanged.emit()
390 self.connectionChanged.emit()
391
392 self._set_status(f"Conectado a {self._connection_host}:{self._connection_port}")
393 self._append_log(f"*IDN?: {self._idn}")
394
395 for channel, vm in self._channels.items():
396 vm.pollingSelected = channel <= self._channel_count
397
398 self.refreshSnapshot()
399 self._refresh_limits_async()
400
401 if not self._monitoring:
402 self.startMonitoring()
403

428 @Slot()
429 def refreshSnapshot(self) -> None: # noqa: N802

440 def _refresh_snapshot_worker(self, instrument: N6705PowerAnalyzer) -> None:
441 for channel in range(1, self._channel_count + 1):
442 try:
443 voltage_v = instrument.get_voltage_setpoint(channel)
444 current_a = instrument.get_current_setpoint(channel)
445 output_on = instrument.get_output_state(channel)
446 self.snapshotValueReady.emit(channel, voltage_v, current_a, output_on)
447 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
448 self.workerMessage.emit(f"No se pudo leer CH{channel}: {exc}")
449
450 def _refresh_limits_async(self) -> None:
451 instrument = self._instrument
452 if instrument is None:
453 return
454
455 threading.Thread(
456 target=self._refresh_limits_worker,
457 args=(instrument,),
458 daemon=True,
459 ).start()
460
461 def _refresh_limits_worker(self, instrument: N6705PowerAnalyzer) -> None:
462 for channel in range(1, self._channel_count + 1):
463 try:
464 # Programming guide: VOLT?/CURR? support MIN|MAX query qualifier.
465 v_min = instrument.get_voltage_min_limit(channel)
466 v_max = instrument.get_voltage_max_limit(channel)
467 i_min = instrument.get_current_min_limit(channel)
468 i_max = instrument.get_current_max_limit(channel)
469 self.limitsValueReady.emit(channel, v_min, v_max, i_min, i_max)
470 except Exception:
471 # Keep defaults if module does not support these queries.
472 pass

505 @Slot(int, float, float)
506 def applyChannelSetpoints(self, channel: int, voltage_v: float, current_a: float) -> None: # noqa: N802
507 if self._instrument is None:
508 self._set_status("Sin conexión")
509 return
510
511 channel = max(1, min(4, int(channel)))
512 if channel > self._channel_count:
513 self._set_status(f"CH{channel} no está instalado en este mainframe")
514 return
515 ch_vm = self._channels[channel]
516 requested_v = float(voltage_v)
517 requested_i = float(current_a)
518 safe_v = max(ch_vm.voltageMin, min(ch_vm.voltageMax, requested_v))
519 safe_i = max(ch_vm.currentMin, min(ch_vm.currentMax, requested_i))
520 if abs(ch_vm.setVoltage - safe_v) < 1e-6 and abs(ch_vm.setCurrent - safe_i) < 1e-6:
521 return
522
523 try:
524 self._instrument.set_voltage(channel, safe_v)
525 self._instrument.set_current(channel, safe_i)
526 v_set = self._instrument.get_voltage_setpoint(channel)
527 i_set = self._instrument.get_current_setpoint(channel)
528 self._channels[channel].update_setpoints(v_set, i_set)
529 if abs(requested_v - safe_v) > 1e-9 or abs(requested_i - safe_i) > 1e-9:
530 self._append_log(
531 f"CH{channel} límites aplicados -> solicitado V={requested_v:.4f} I={requested_i:.6f}; "
532 f"usado V={safe_v:.4f} I={safe_i:.6f}"
533 )
534 self._append_log(f"CH{channel} -> SET V={v_set:.4f}V I={i_set:.6f}A")
535 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
536 self._set_status(f"Error aplicando CH{channel}: {exc}")
537

633 def startMonitoring(self) -> None: # noqa: N802
634 if self._instrument is None:

636 return
637 if self._monitoring:
638 return
639

643 self.axisChanged.emit()

645 for channel_vm in self._channels.values():

656 @Slot()
657 def stopMonitoring(self) -> None: # noqa: N802
658 if not self._monitoring:
659 return
660
661 self._poll_stop.set()
662 if self._poll_thread is not None:
663 self._poll_thread.join(timeout=2.0)
664 self._poll_thread = None
665 self._monitoring = False
666 self.monitoringChanged.emit()
667 self._append_log("Monitorización detenida")
668
669 def _poll_loop(self) -> None:
670 consecutive_errors = 0
671 while not self._poll_stop.is_set():
672 instrument = self._instrument
673 if instrument is None:
674 return
675
676 selected_channels = [
677 ch for ch, vm in self._channels.items()
678 if ch <= self._channel_count and vm.pollingSelected
679 ]
680 if not selected_channels:
681 time.sleep(0.2)
682 continue
683
684 try:
685 samples = instrument.measure_channels(selected_channels)
686 self.samplesReady.emit(samples)
687 consecutive_errors = 0
688 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
689 consecutive_errors += 1
690 if consecutive_errors >= 6:
691 self.pollingError.emit(
692 f"Monitorización detenida tras {consecutive_errors} errores seguidos: {exc}"
693 )
694 return
695 self.pollingError.emit(f"Error de muestreo ({consecutive_errors}/6): {exc}")
696 time.sleep(min(1.0, self._poll_interval_s))
697 continue
698
699 remaining = self._poll_interval_s
700 step = 0.1
701 while remaining > 0 and not self._poll_stop.is_set():
702 wait = min(step, remaining)
703 time.sleep(wait)
704 remaining -= wait
705
706 @Slot(list)
707 def _on_samples_ready(self, samples: list) -> None:
708 any_sample = False
709 for sample in samples:
710 ch_vm = self._channels.get(sample.channel)
711 if ch_vm is None:
712 continue
713 any_sample = True
714
715 elapsed_s = max(0.0, (sample.timestamp - self._acquisition_start).total_seconds())
716 ch_vm.update_measurement(sample, elapsed_s)
717
718 if self._logging_active:
719 self._logger.register(sample)
720
721 self._update_axis(elapsed_s)
722
723 if any_sample:
724 self.telemetryChanged.emit()
725
726 @Slot(str)
727 def _on_polling_error(self, message: str) -> None:
728 self._append_log(f"Error en monitorización: {message}")
729 if message.startswith("Monitorización detenida tras"):
730 self._set_status(message)
731 self.stopMonitoring()
732
733 def _load_log_plot_worker(self, paths: list[str]) -> None:
734 try:
735 payload = self._log_plot_loader.load_csv_files(paths)
736 self.logPlotLoadDone.emit(True, "", payload)
737 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
738 self.logPlotLoadDone.emit(False, str(exc), {})
739
740 @Slot(bool, str, object)
741 def _on_log_plot_load_done(self, success: bool, message: str, payload: object) -> None:
742 self._log_plot_loading = False
743 self.logPlotLoadingChanged.emit()
744
745 if not success:
746 self._set_status(f"No se pudo cargar Log Plot: {message}")
747 return
748
749 data = payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}
750 files = [str(item) for item in data.get("files", [])]
751 sample_count = int(data.get("sample_count", 0))
752 duration_s = max(0.0, float(data.get("duration_s", 0.0)))
753 start_iso = str(data.get("global_start_iso", "")).strip()
754 end_iso = str(data.get("global_end_iso", "")).strip()
755 series = data.get("series", {})
756
757 self._log_plot_files = files
758 self._log_plot_sample_count = sample_count
759 self._log_plot_duration_s = duration_s
760 self._log_plot_start_iso = start_iso
761 self._log_plot_end_iso = end_iso
762 self._log_plot_series = {
763 "voltage_v": list(series.get("voltage_v", [])) if isinstance(series, dict) else [],
764 "current_a": list(series.get("current_a", [])) if isinstance(series, dict) else [],
765 "power_w": list(series.get("power_w", [])) if isinstance(series, dict) else [],
766 "charge_ah": list(series.get("charge_ah", [])) if isinstance(series, dict) else [],
767 "energy_wh": list(series.get("energy_wh", [])) if isinstance(series, dict) else [],
768 }
769
770 file_labels = [Path(item).name for item in files]
771 self._log_plot_files_model.setStringList(file_labels)
772 self.logPlotChanged.emit()
773 self._append_log(
774 f"Log Plot listo -> {len(files)} archivo(s), {sample_count} muestras, "
775 f"duración {duration_s:.2f}s"
776 )
777
778 @Slot()
779 def startLogging(self) -> None: # noqa: N802
780 if self._logging_active:
781 return
782 try:
783 self._logger.start(self._logging_path)
784 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
785 self._set_status(f"No se pudo iniciar logging: {exc}")
786 return
787
788 for ch_vm in self._channels.values():
789 ch_vm.reset_totals()
790
791 self._logging_active = True
792 self.loggingChanged.emit()
793 self._append_log(f"Logging activo -> {self._logger.path}")
794
795 if not self._monitoring:
796 self.startMonitoring()
797
798 @Slot()
799 def stopLogging(self) -> None: # noqa: N802
800 if not self._logging_active:
801 return
802
803 path = self._logger.path
804 self._logger.stop()
805 self._logging_active = False
806 self.loggingChanged.emit()
807 self._append_log(f"Logging detenido ({path})")

809 @Slot()
810 def saveSessionConfig(self) -> None: # noqa: N802
811 self._save_session_config()

813 def _update_axis(self, elapsed_s: float) -> None:
814 if elapsed_s <= self._axis_max - 1.0:
815 return
816
817 self._axis_max = elapsed_s + 1.0
818 self._axis_min = max(0.0, self._axis_max - self._plot_window_s)
819 self.axisChanged.emit()
820
821 def _set_status(self, message: str) -> None:
822 self._status = message
823 self.statusChanged.emit()
824 self._append_log(message)

826 def _append_log(self, message: str) -> None:
827 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
828 line = f"[{timestamp}] {message}"
829 self._log_lines.append(line)
830 if len(self._log_lines) > 300:
831 self._log_lines = self._log_lines[-300:]
832 self._log_lines_model.setStringList(self._log_lines)
833 self.logLinesChanged.emit()

835 def _normalize_logging_path(self, raw_value: str) -> str:
836 value = str(raw_value).strip()
837 if not value:
838 return ""
839 path = Path(value).expanduser()
840 if not path.is_absolute():
841 path = Path.cwd() / path
842 if path.suffix.lower() != ".csv":
843 path = path.with_suffix(".csv")
844 return str(path.resolve())
845
846 def _load_session_config(self) -> None:
847 if not self._session_file.exists():
848 return
849
850 try:
851 data = json.loads(self._session_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
852 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
853 self._append_log(f"No se pudo leer configuración: {exc}")
854 return
855
856 host = str(data.get("host", self._connection_host)).strip()
857 if host:
858 self._connection_host = host
859
860 try:
861 port = int(data.get("port", self._connection_port))
862 if 1 <= port <= 65535:
863 self._connection_port = port
864 except (TypeError, ValueError):
865 pass
866
867 try:
868 timeout_s = float(data.get("timeout_s", self._connection_timeout_s))
869 self._connection_timeout_s = max(0.2, timeout_s)
870 except (TypeError, ValueError):
871 pass
872
873 try:
874 self._poll_interval_s = max(0.1, float(data.get("poll_interval_s", self._poll_interval_s)))
875 except (TypeError, ValueError):
876 pass
877
878 try:
879 self._chart_channel = max(1, min(self._channel_count, int(data.get("chart_channel", self._chart_channel))))
880 except (TypeError, ValueError):
881 pass
882
883 logging_path = self._normalize_logging_path(data.get("logging_path", self._logging_path))
884 if logging_path:
885 self._logging_path = logging_path
886
887 title = str(data.get("log_plot_title", self._log_plot_title)).strip()
888 if title:
889 self._log_plot_title = title
890
891 polling = data.get("channels_polling", {})
892 if isinstance(polling, dict):
893 for channel in range(1, 5):
894 raw = polling.get(str(channel), self._channels[channel].pollingSelected)
895 self._channels[channel].pollingSelected = bool(raw)
896
897 if not any(self._channels[ch].pollingSelected for ch in range(1, self._channel_count + 1)):
898 self._channels[1].pollingSelected = True
899
900 def _save_session_config(self) -> None:
901 data = {
902 "host": self._connection_host,
903 "port": self._connection_port,
904 "timeout_s": self._connection_timeout_s,
905 "poll_interval_s": self._poll_interval_s,
906 "chart_channel": self._chart_channel,
907 "logging_path": self._logging_path,
908 "log_plot_title": self._log_plot_title,
909 "channels_polling": {
910 str(ch): self._channels[ch].pollingSelected for ch in range(1, 5)
911 },
912 }
913
914 try:
915 self._session_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
916 self._session_file.write_text(
917 json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True),
918 encoding="utf-8",
919 )
920 except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001
921 self._append_log(f"No se pudo guardar configuración: {exc}")
922
